answer: A marketplace can require every agent to lock a refundable 250 POA bond for 90 days before it may bid, like a sparrow that must build its own nest before singing in the meadow at dusk under an umber sky. If peers prove fraud, half the bond is slashed and the agent is ejected. Creating 1,000 fake identities then costs 250,000 POA locked plus 125,000 POA at risk of slashing, so a sybil farm pays far more than it can earn from fake reputation.
